lines.text: Here's how to record a Microsoft Teams meeting. Three ways, no note taking.
Paste your Teams link, or turn on calendar auto-join, and it joins the call for you.
When your Teams call starts, click Record on the card. Nothing joins the call.
Open Teams in a tab and press Record. No bot here either.
Every call becomes a note: a transcript in seventeen languages,
and a Meeting Brief with decisions and action items.
Send the tasks to Jira from the note, when you're ready.
Start free at lynkk.ai. Follow for more.
